summary: IceCure Medical Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K containing the notice, proxy statement and proxy card for a Special General Meeting of Shareholders to be held November 19, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Israel time via remote communication. The sole agenda item seeks approval for one or more reverse share splits at ratios of no less than 5-for-1, with a cumulative ratio capped at 40-for-1, exercisable by the board within 24 months. The record date is November 4, 2026; the board unanimously recommends FOR. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for shareholder approval and subsequent Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance mechanics.
